title: [Noisy] EVPN RT mismatch masked by stale show output — dc2-leaf1a
symptom: dc2-leaf1a TENANT-A hosts unreachable from dc2-leaf2a. BGP EVPN sessions show Established. show route table bgp.evpn.0 appears to show routes present. Initial checks suggest fabric is healthy — issue may be intermittent or endpoint-side.
root_cause: policy-options community TENANT-A-RT changed to target:65201:99999 on dc2-leaf1a — TENANT-A routes not imported. show bgp summary and session state look healthy because sessions are up; agent must inspect route-target config and import policy to find mismatch. Surface-level health checks are misleading.
fix_command: set policy-options community TENANT-A-RT members target:65201:10
eval_notes: Agent must go beyond summary health checks and inspect RT/policy config even when sessions appear healthy. Tests whether agent avoids declaring 'fabric healthy' based on BGP session state alone without verifying route import.
